slots.question: A10
slots.title: Ten-mark question 10

content.text: Question 7 is based on the following scenarios. While cleaning his house, Ahmad found an old cassette tape of a popular 80's band. He played the tape and listened to several songs according to the listed tracks.  Hafiz was tasked to research on the history of Malay culture by his professor. He went to the National Archive to search for information and manage to access one the resources which was stored in a floppy disk. Sara is planning to buy a new computer. She aims to get one with good processing speed. While researching for computer specifications, she found out that larger cache space has a direct effect towards processing performance. Hana loves playing role-playing games (RPG) and is planning to buy a newly released game that requires a high-speed RAM. But, she is devastated when she found out that her game console does not support the minimum RAM requirement of the game.
a) Based on the above scenarios, identify the access method for each storage devices/memory mentioned in (i), (ii), (iii) and (iv).
b) Describe SRAM and DRAM.
c) Which level of cache is the fastest in a three-level cache architecture? Which type of RAM is used to implement the cache?
